title: Good Fortune Collection: Three Leather Projects to Ring in the New Year
summary: Create three beginner-friendly leather projects in this 9-minute build-along featuring a tarot case, fortune teller, and fortune cookie keychain.
body_markdown:
The **Good Fortune Collection** brings a little intention and fun into your leathercraft with three small, giftable projects you can make in a single afternoon:


-


A **Leather Tarot Card Case**


-


A **Leather Fortune Teller**


-


A **Leather Fortune Cookie Keychain**


In our latest YouTube build-along, we walk through each project step by step, showing how to turn small cuts of leather into meaningful keepsakes using simple tools and beginner-friendly techniques.


### Watch the Build-Along


This build-along is designed to be fast, approachable, and inspiring. It is perfect for beginners or experienced makers looking for a quick, creative win.


Each piece can stand alone, but together they create a cohesive themed collection that’s ideal for New Year builds, handmade gifts, or craft fair inventory.


### Leather Tarot Card Case


A clean, minimal case designed to protect a standard tarot deck. This project is great for practicing hand stitching.


### Leather Fortune Teller


A leather take on the classic paper fortune teller. This playful project is perfect for scrap leather and color blocking, and it always sparks conversation.


### Leather Fortune Cookie Keychain (optional)


Quick to make and endlessly giftable, this fortune cookie is ideal for using up offcuts and creating small batch items with big charm.


### Who This Build-Along Is For


The **Good Fortune Collection** is perfect if you:


-


Are new to leathercraft


-


Enjoy small, satisfying projects


-


Want quick, giftable builds


-


Love themed or storytelling-driven designs


All three projects require minimal materials and basic tools, making them accessible without sacrificing creativity.


### Start Your Good Fortune Build - Download for FREE


Whether you’re crafting for the New Year or just looking for a fun weekend project, the **Good Fortune Collection** is a great way to create something meaningful by hand.
